notes: 68 experiments under experiments/p6-autopoiesis/, all assigned family autopoiesis-succession (succ) per the phase rule; default disposition active (triage to canonical/superseded handled separately). No experiment is marked superseded or design-only in its README, so no superseded/design-only dispositions were assigned. No nested experiment suites: every experiment dir is flat (children are only support dirs runs/analysis/prompts/, no deeper ID-prefixed dirs). IDs jump from 6.3 to 6.5 (no 6.4 directory on disk) and 6.18/6.19 are sibling repair variants (no slug collision). Frontmatter is inconsistent across the phase: 6.1-6.27 use a few YAML-frontmatter READMEs but most (6.5-6.27) carry only blockquote Type/Status; 6.28-6.68 use no YAML frontmatter at all (bold **Type/Status** header lines or Paper-Facing Read tables). experiment_type was therefore inferred as single-run for the great majority (transmutation/pressure/repair single-runs), dataset-eval for the ladder experiments 6.3/6.62/6.63, and lineage where the README explicitly says lineage (6.5-6.10). For 6.46-6.52 several READMEs have no explicit status line; status inferred from context (experimental for minimal pressure-ablation probes, baseline-recorded for established attractors). 6.64 status normalized to live-positive-recorded (README: 'live positive recorded'). Paper Feeds: most experiments feed alife/quine-cognitive-autopoiesis (primary autopoiesis paper) or are none-yet; 6.1-6.3 additionally feed quine-lifelike, quine-process-habitat, and system/quine-hotos. theory_objects inferred from Paper Feeds + hypotheses using the closed vocabulary.
